messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PROD deploy 2026-03-15 03:04 UTC - service 'inference-gateway' error rate spiked to 18% after rollout started. trace id: a1b2c3
incident-bot: Paging -> @jamie (oncall) — please acknowledge. Impact: 10% of requests 5xx, partial region outage (us-west-2).
jamie (oncall): acknowledged. jumping in. anyone know what changed in this release?
tariq: this was a small config change: switched KMS key alias to `alias/redwood-new` and updated env var `KMS_KEY_ID`. rollout started ~03:02 UTC.
maria: quick check — I see logs where kms.Decrypt is returning AccessDenied for the new key. service logs: `AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::... is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:.../key/1234`
jamie (oncall): oh. so secrets can't be read -> service can't load model creds -> 5xx.
lee: confirmed canary hosts show repeated failures while old hosts healthy. canary % of traffic was 10% initially, but rollout bumped to 60% due to autoscale rule.
tariq: that explains quick blast radius. I think key policy change during rotation didn't include the inference role.
maria: immediate mitigation: kill feature flag for deploy so traffic reverts to previous variant, and roll back env var to old KMS alias.
jamie (oncall): agree. can someone flip flag? @maria do you have permissions?
maria: doing it now. /flag --service inference-gateway --flag deploy_variant --value old --reason "kms decrypt failures"
maria: :white_check_mark: flag flipped. Confirming traffic should switch back to old variant.
jamie (oncall): monitoring... error rate dropping?
(30s pause)
lee: error rate down to 3% now. Canary hosts moving back to baseline. Nice.
tariq: I'll start rollback of the env change in the deployment pipeline. command:
```
kubectl set env deployment/inference-gateway KMS_KEY_ID=alias/redwood-old -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-gateway -n prod
```
(tariq posts)
jamie (oncall): heads-up to customer-success: some customers in us-west-2 saw up to ~25% failed requests for ~3 minutes during ramp.
maria: filing incident ticket and CC'ing cs.
maria: incident ticket: INC-2026-314 -> brief: KMS rotation omitted inference role in key policy; resulted in secrets decrypt failing on new deploy; mitigation: flag kill + rollback to previous KMS alias + policy fix pending.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-314 created and linked to thread 1910001111. Priority: P1 -> P2 (after rollback).
jamie (oncall): handing over to @tariq for policy fix and postmortem. I'm going to keep monitoring for 15m then hand off to night oncall.
tariq: I'll update key policy immediately and redeploy a patched rollout once validated. Changes to be pushed to infra repo: `infra/iam/kms/redwood-new-policy.json`
maria: sample policy diff I will apply (adding inference service role):
```
-  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inference-service"},
+  "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inference-service","arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-bot"]},
```
lee: after policy update, let's run a quick decrypt smoke test against a canary host before re-enabling rollout.
tariq: agreed. i'll do policy change, then run this: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://secret.bin --key-id alias/redwood-new --region us-west-2` from a canary.
maria: documenting customer impact: approx 10-15 customers (high-traffic) experienced errors, SLO breach window ~03:02-03:06 UTC, estimated error budget hit ~0.6%.
jamie (oncall): thumbs up. once verified, coordinate a slow canary with 2% increments and watch error/latency. We'll keep the incident ticket updated.
(15m later)
jamie (oncall): handoff to night team: @lee you're primary for monitoring until 07:00 UTC. Leave ticket open until postmortem.
lee: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye and post verification logs.
tariq: policy patch applied and verified via decrypt test. ready to resume rollout after lee confirms smoke checks.
maria: adding follow-up tasks: 1) automated integration test to validate kms:Decrypt for new key during rotation; 2) add pre-deploy IAM policy check to pipeline; 3) postmortem.
jamie (oncall): good. closing urgent mitigation. Next steps in INC-2026-314. Thanks everyone. :v:
